capabilities: Render GFM strikethrough, task lists, footnotes and definition lists in notes
Render LaTeX and mhchem chemistry formulas with KaTeX
Convert Notion HTML exports into Obsidian Markdown with callouts and tables
Export notes to standard Markdown, converting wikilinks and stripping plugin metadata
Batch import or export entire folders or vaults
extras: Freemium: free tier limits imports to 5 files; Pro features unlocked via license key in settings. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a detailed troubleshooting section.
intentEvidence: LaTeX Enhancement — Block ($$...$$) and inline ($...$) formula rendering powered by KaTeX
problem: Obsidian's wikilinks, footnote handling and math rendering differ from standard Markdown/GFM, and it has no built-in way to convert Notion HTML exports or produce portable standard Markdown for other tools.

relations.evidence: Notion Import — Convert Notion HTML exports to Obsidian-compatible Markdown

requires.name: Pro license key for Notion import, Markdown export and batch operations

summary: Markdown compatibility toolkit that renders GFM syntax and LaTeX in notes, imports Notion HTML exports, and exports notes to standard Markdown.
